metadata.title: Bitcoin and Strategy Stock Jump. Why Cryptos Are Rallying Against All Odds.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Bitcoin and Strategy Stock Are Rallying Against All the Odds
The collapse of the Clarity Act and a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike ought to have been a toxic combination for Bitcoin, but the world’s largest cryptocurrency has shown its resilience this week.
